content: Crypto Service Manager (CSM) The CSM provides standardized cryptographic services to applications and security modules (SecOC, TLS, IPsec) through asynchronous jobs and synchronous primitives. function Csm_Encrypt [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00001] Std_ReturnType Csm_Encrypt(uint32 jobId, Crypto_OperationModeType mode, const uint8* dataPtr, uint32 dataLength, uint8* resultPtr, uint32* resultLengthPtr); Performs symmetric or asymmetric encryption using configured cryptographic keys (e.g. AES-128/256-CBC, RSA, ECC). function Csm_Decrypt [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00003] Std_ReturnType Csm_Decrypt(uint32 jobId, Crypto_OperationModeType mode, const uint8* dataPtr, uint32 dataLength, uint8* resultPtr, uint32* resultLengthPtr); Performs cryptographic decryption of ciphertext blocks with padding validation. function Csm_MacGenerate [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00004] Std_ReturnType Csm_MacGenerate(uint32 jobId, Crypto_OperationModeType mode, const uint8* dataPtr, uint32 dataLength, uint8* macPtr, uint32* macLengthPtr); Calculates a Message Authentication Code (e.g. CMAC-AES, HMAC-SHA256) for SecOC message authentication. function Csm_KeyElementSet [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00005] Std_ReturnType Csm_KeyElementSet(uint32 keyId, uint32 keyElementId, const uint8* keyPtr, uint32 keyLength); Sets a key element inside a designated key slot in volatile RAM or non-volatile HSM storage. Crypto Interface (CryIf) CryIf routes CSM jobs to specific hardware crypto drivers (HSM, SHE, TPM) or software crypto implementations. function CryIf_ProcessJob [SWS_CP_CRYPTO_00010] Std_ReturnType CryIf_ProcessJob(uint32 channelId, Crypto_JobType* job); Dispatches the cryptographic job to the mapped physical driver channel.
